title: Prove the BIT owner-411 ingress rank obstruction and replay a shared bridge
body:
Fixed chart 1 has 537 independent output rows and 537 one-field paid arrivals. Deleting one arrival cannot preserve those outputs. A separate 5,100-case direct-injection/cheaper-chart span screen excludes the stated replacements. Two reversible controls pass both operators; the sharper changes the bridge roles and returns 411 through packet 3544. It ties every signed bin and adds 4,882,176 raw records over 36 calls.

Pinned #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. This deliberately opens the bridge protected in #7881 and the three-component screen. python3 -B verify.py and all four checks passed from a cold copy, including the missing-injection mutation. Original contributors credited. OpenAI Codex assisted.
